name: 💾 Build INSERT SQL
func:
var d = msg.payload;

msg.topic = "INSERT INTO sensor_data (node, soil, hall, mag, tip, tilt, rain, rssi, snr, timestamp) VALUES ('" 
    + d.node + "', " 
    + d.soil + ", " 
    + d.hall + ", " 
    + d.mag + ", " 
    + d.tip + ", " 
    + d.tilt + ", " 
    + (d.rain || 0) + ", " 
    + (d.rssi || 0) + ", " 
    + (d.snr || 0) + ", '" 
    + d.timestamp + "')";

return msg;

name: 🚀 Startup (Buat Tabel)
topic: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensor_data (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, node TEXT, soil INTEGER, hall INTEGER, mag INTEGER, tip INTEGER, tilt REAL, rain REAL, rssi INTEGER, snr REAL, timestamp TEXT)
